approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue, a game-specific runtime standing in for the Xbox, drawn by the SDK's Xenos renderer on Vulkan only (no D3D12). Windows first, then native Linux and the Steam Deck.
notes: Bootstrapped 2026-10-29 from the lotr-conquest-360-recomp shape with the Dead or Alive Xtreme 2 recomp's engine knowledge (same Team Ninja engine). First translation and build next. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy.
